method: apply the patch to a clean clone at base, npm run build, node --test each test/*.test.js file on its own, record every top-level not-ok. Classification is CC's judgement from what each test READS (docs/test-program.md §8.1) -- not checked by a second reader.

tests.test: ⛔ every rule in app.css targets something a page can carry
the scoreboard states the mode the URL asked for: "?strength=even" -> EVEN STRENGTH
the scoreboard states the mode the URL asked for: "?strength=all" -> ALL SITUATIONS
the scoreboard states the mode the URL asked for: "" -> ALL SITUATIONS
the scoreboard states the mode the URL asked for: "?strength=sideways" -> ALL SITUATIONS
⭐ the rendered DOM is identical to the golden, frame for frame
the attempts derive.py publishes are the attempts the counter reaches
the ledger lists nothing that is already back in the light
no bare percentage survives on the scoreboard
the strength mode reaches the scoreboard, not only the counters
⭐ the preview runs with the Control layer ON, so the hero shows what the h1 promises
⭐ the control bar claims nothing before anything has been counted
⭐ the preview begins where the layer first counts something
a deep link lands without pretending the whole game just happened
⭐⭐ a scrub re-bases the flash, so playing after a drag does not fire for the drag
first paint is the PRE-GAME state, not the final score and not a play
a full render at the end puts the right numbers in the DOM
the strength filter moves the numbers on screen, with the mode attached
a metric added mid-replay catches up, tracks forward, and tears down
a link to a moment opens there, and says nothing
⭐ the rendered DOM is identical to the golden, frame for frame
overtime is NAMED, and says how many skaters are on the ice
a link to the opening faceoff still lands on it
the first step forward lands on the opening draw
as-played rotates the periods the arena rotated, and only those
the club behind the net travels with the net when the ends turn over
a zone-start ring turns over with the rink, and only in the periods that did
the ends key arrives at the first period the ends did NOT switch
the empty-net note is present exactly while a net is really empty
the clock shows time remaining, not elapsed
